errors.evidence: The machine-generated description does not mention the purpose of the charts, which is to show the investments of territorial authorities in relation to GDP from 1991 to 2023.
The machine-generated description does not describe the horizontal axis (years from 1991 to 2023) or the vertical axis (percentage of GDP, ranging from -0.5 to 3.5).
The machine-generated description does not mention the two charts (left for gross fixed capital investments and right for net fixed capital investments).
The machine-generated description does not mention the breakdown of bars by levels of territorial authorities: 'Bund' (blue), 'Länder' (violet), and 'Gemeinden' (green).
The machine-generated description does not mention the black line representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' (total investments of territorial authorities).

The machine-generated description does not mention the trends in the left chart, such as the high values in the early 1990s (above 3% of GDP), the decline until 2000, and the stable development between 2% and 3% thereafter.

The machine-generated description does not mention the trends in the right chart, such as the lower values of net investments compared to gross investments, the early 1990s values around 0.7%, the subsequent decline into negative territory, and the movement between 0% and 0.5% over most of the period.
The machine-generated description does not mention the slight upward trends in net investments since 2015, peaking below 0.6% and ending slightly above zero.
